from pathlib import Path
import importlib.util, sys
runtime=Path.home()/'.local/share/prediction-chat-bridge'
sys.path.insert(0,str(runtime))
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('installed_bridge_status_compaction',runtime/'bridge_server.py')
mod=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
assert getattr(mod.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatWake/1.0-status-compaction'
raw='\n'.join([
 'RESULT_READY: DEV-OUTER-E001',
 'Exit code: 0',
 '=== WSL RESULT ===',
 'DEV_TASK_ID=DEV-OUTER-E001',
 'COMMAND_1_BEGIN=python3',
 'DEV_TASK_ID=DEV-INNER-E009',
 'COMMAND_1_RC=2',
 'DEV_TASK_STATUS=FAIL',
 'ERROR_CLASS=TaskError',
 'COMMAND_1_RC=0',
 'DEV_TASK_STATUS=PASS',
])
msg=mod.compact_delivery_event({'event_id':'runtime-e013','task_id':'DEV-OUTER-E001','message':raw})['message']
assert 'status=PASS' in msg and 'exit=0' in msg and 'rcs=1:0' in msg
assert 'error=' not in msg and '1:2' not in msg
assert getattr(mod.session.Handler,'server_version','')=='PredictionChatWake/0.9-session-bootstrap'
assert callable(getattr(mod.session,'ensure_session_bootstrap',None))
print('STATUS_COMPACTION_E013=PASS')
print('HANDLER_VERSION='+mod.Handler.server_version)
print('COMPACTED='+msg)
